Hi team —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Following up with a concise ops plan so we can finalize the localized invite cadence and the SMS opt-in flow before we send wave 1. Key goals: keep EU consent language compliant, minimize friction for registration, and preserve token-level tracking for post-event attribution.

Ask summary (can we align by EOD Mon?):
- Marissa: confirm target segments and preferred send windows for DE/FR/ES locales.
- Mateo: map UTM/tracking links + Eventify registration tags we need to capture (source, campaign, locale, channel, sms_optin).
- Naomi: confirm legal-approved consent snippet & data retention wording for GDPR (we'll attach example).

Suggested flow (high level):
1) Email invite (localized subject/preview) -> primary CTA to Eventify registration page with UTM params.
2) On-registration: show localized consent snippet (consent-snippet.html attached) with a checkbox for marketing emails and a separate checkbox for SMS opt-in.
3) If user checks SMS opt-in, send double opt-in SMS with link that confirms consent (twilio will handle sending). Only mark contact as sms_confirmed after they click confirmation link.
4) Capture sms_confirmed boolean in HubSpot along with registration. Use webhook from Eventify to our ingestion endpoint.

Tracking & mapping notes for Mateo: use token fingerprinting (first-click + hidden token) to reconcile registration -> sms confirmation -> attendance. Eventify supports a 2-step webhook for registration and conversion events; see related_links.

I've attached an initial segment matrix and a draft consent snippet and SMS copy to review.

Attachments: segment-matrix.csv, consent-snippet.html, sms-copy.txt

Sample SMS (first pass):
"Hi {firstName}, thanks for registering for the Redwood Inference webinar. Reply YES or click {confirm_link} to confirm SMS updates. Msg&Data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out"

Notes: prefer confirm_link to include short-lived token for security and to map back to the Eventify registration id.

Thanks — Soojin

Great context — thanks Sarah. Quick replies inline and an updated implementation plan below.

- Timing: moving DE/FR to Thu works — Marissa will confirm final send windows.
- Retention: Naomi — proposed retention windows: marketing contact record (email + sms_optin flags) retained for 24 months; sms delivery logs retained for 6 months; confirmed consenting event retained 36 months. If legal requires shorter windows we can update.
- Confirm link hosting: Redwood can host a lightweight redirect endpoint (https://rwd.ai/sms-confirm) that forwards to Acme after token validation. This keeps tracking consistent for attribution while showing Acme's domain on the final landing page. Sarah — does that satisfy trust needs?

Updated implementation checklist (next 48 hours):
1) Marissa: finalize segments and locale send times (by EOD Tue).
2) Mateo: produce tracking map CSV with UTM examples and Eventify webhook field names (I'll add a sample mapping below).
3) Naomi: confirm consent wording and retention windows; provide any mandatory phrasing for DE/FR.
4) Acme (Sarah): share legal contact + confirm confirm_link domain preference.
5) Twilio: confirm SMS throughput and short-code vs long-code recommendation (we need ~5k confirmation SMS only).

Sample UTM mapping (short):

Eventify custom fields to capture: registration_id, partner_ref, sms_optin (true/false), token_id

Attachments: consent-snippet.html, sms-copy.txt, segment-matrix.csv

If no objections, I'll push these changes to the Eventify event and open the webhook to /webhooks/eventify/registration.

On Thu we'll run a small 500-person pilot in DE to validate link flow and sms confirmation before full wave.

We can support 5k confirmation SMS with a standard long-code throughput; short-code not necessary for one-off confirmations. Notes: average delivery SLA in DE/FR/ES is 99.4% within 30s; opt-out handling (STOP) is automatic if using our Messaging Service. Costs estimate: ~€0.02 per confirmation SMS, so budget ~€100 for 5k messages (plus delivery fees).

We'll provision a Messaging Service and share credentials via a secure ticket; please confirm sender ID and the from-number preference.
